name: dumbbell straight arm pullover v. 2
description: A pullover variation with straight arms that stretches and works the chest and lats through a long arc.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Keep a slight softness in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the weight in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips on the bench.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
